messages:
maria_sales: Quick ask — FinBank wants a definitive region map + full subprocessor attestation for their SOC2 scoping. They also want a priced option if we enforce EU-only routing for their tenant. They asked for a 2-week tenant-pin POC. Who can own the runbook, exportable artifacts, and a draft quote? cc @sam_infra @olga_security

sam_infra: I can own infra side. Need to confirm which EU zones we can pin to and whether tenant pinning changes the subproc set. Also need ops to confirm capacity for a 2-week reserved pool.

olga_security: I'll pull the current subprocessor attestation and region map. Heads-up: some fallback paths (embeddings fallback) use GCP europe-west2; if we pin strictly to AWS eu-west-1 we may need to remove that fallback. Also need FinBank's SOC2 scoping doc to confirm required controls.

mateo_sales_eng: For pricing guidance: historically EU-only (no cross-border egress/fallback) adds ~15–20% on infra costs for reserved capacity and potential premium for dedicated tenancy for PII. I can draft a quote but need expected QPS and avg token/response.

maria_sales: They said ~100 qps steady, mostly short chat sessions, avg token output ~120. PII redaction required. I'll attach a short SOW after the call.

olga_security: Noted about PII. Current subproc list (summary): AWS (eu-west-1 primary), GCP (europe-west2 embeddings fallback), FastEdge CDN (DE/FR edge pops), Sentry (error reporting). If we force strict routing we can exclude GCP fallback but that increases risk for embedding tail latency/failures. Will provide formal attestation document.

sam_infra: Operationally we can enforce strict routing with a tenant-level policy. Example policy snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  tenant_pin: true
  region_policy:
    primary: [eu-west-1]
    failover: []
```
That disables failover; note cold KV misses may add a few 10s ms tail latency. Also need to pre-allocate reserved GPU pool for the POC.

lisa_legal: Legal ask: we need subprocessors' DPA clauses for EU-only commitments and the cert/IP list. FinBank's legal wants cert chains for endpoints and a contact for incident escalation.

olivia_ops: I can export cert chains and current IP ranges. Will prepare a zipped artifact and an S3 link (encrypted) — ETA today EOD.

mateo_sales_eng: I'll prepare two priced options: (A) Strict EU-only (no fallback) — +18% infra uplift + dedicated tenancy option for PII; (B) EU-preferred with GCP fallback — +5% uplift, lower risk. Draft should be ready tomorrow morning if infra gives capacity numbers.

maria_sales: :thumbsup: Please also prepare a short runbook (activation steps, monitoring checklist, rollback steps) so CS can run the 2-week trial with minimal handholding. Ops + Infra, can you collab?

sam_infra: Will draft the runbook: steps will include allocate reserved GPU pool in eu-west-1, enable tenant pinning, disable failover, confirm KV prefix cache priming, and add Prometheus/trace dashboards for latency and error spikes. I'll post the runbook link when complete.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ticket INFRA-5421 created for "FinBank EU-only POC - tenant pin and reserved capacity" assigned to @sam_infra.

olga_security: Sending redlined subproc attestation to @maria_sales now. Also: if we remove GCP fallback, embeddings quality regression is estimated ~2% on small eval set — need explicit client sign-off for quality vs. residency tradeoff.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll present choices to FinBank legal: (1) Strict EU-only (higher cost, higher residency assurance, small quality risk), or (2) EU-preferred with GCP fallback (lower cost, lower risk). Will loop back after their legal call and share the SOW.
